references.credit: Anadolu Agency public photo; local visual reference only, not redistributed or used as a texture.
references.observed: Actually inspected cropped aerial of the restored upper bailey: a circular crenellated tower and adjacent D-shaped/rounded tower, open stone courts, terraced walks/stairs, low double walls, large square tower masses and modern small glass exhibition cover. It does not show the entire castle; do not treat it as a complete site survey. Trees/exhibits/water are context, not copied textures.

references.credit: Wikimedia Commons file page supplies author/license; local visual reference only, not redistributed or used as a texture.
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary upper-court view: small Gothic chapel with terracotta gable roof and pointed windows/portal, pale round minaret, broad square stone towers, irregular crenellated parapets and stepped stone walks/walls. A low bath dome with round rooflights is visible near the viewpoint. Preserve distinct building levels and open court spaces; exact internal inventories remain approximate.

references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary French Tower close view: near-square battered/pale mixed-stone body, high slit/arched window and small lower doorway, projecting corbels and stepped merlons. Fine masonry joints, individual reliefs and ornament counts are not measured or copied as private textures.

references.credit: Ordinary public Bodrum overview photo;local reference only,not redistributed or used as a texture.
references.observed: Actually inspected whole-castle aerial overview: full rocky peninsula perimeter and double curtain walls, five principal tower masses, open upper/lower courtyards and internal ranges, chapel/minaret near the western side, distinct French/Italian high pair and tall English tower at the far seaward corner. Outer walls follow the shoreline; the retained polygon is a wall perimeter rather than a solid building footprint. Marina, town, trees, sea and boats are excluded from the structure mesh.

method: Four ordinary photographs actually inspected plus retained castle outline, standard viewer PMTiles buildings/POI labels and one global terrain tile. No bespoke surveys, PDFs, archival research or downloaded meshes. Photographs are local reference only and not redistributed or used as textures.
uninspectedReferences: Three additional original Commons tower images were rate-limited. They have not been inspected and do not support any review or completion claim. Current four pictures support the full exterior layout and principal forms; further ordinary views may be used only if needed for actual geometry.
